title: 第5章 村长夜归第6章 叶开报仇
content_zh:
“你怎么回来了？”王艳的声音。
“嘿嘿，我想你了，回来看看你啊！”是张有权的声音，
叶开顿时紧张起来，张有权怎么回来了？
“我才不信呢，这还没一天呢，你就想我了？”
“开完会了，我寻思在县里待着没啥意思，就回来了。”
“我说嘛，你有这么好！”
“我还真是想你了，中午我跟一帮人吃饭，吃了羊球，喝了三鞭酒，现在憋得难受呢！”
“你没在外面找小姐？”
“别胡说，我家里守着这么漂亮的媳妇，怎么能找小姐呢！”
“哼，谁知道你找没找？”
“你试试不就知道了吗？”张有权搂住了王艳，开始动手动脚。
“不要嘛。”王艳躲躲闪闪的。
张有权更来劲了，抱着王艳摸起来。
王艳刚才的酥劲还没过去，很快就被摸得浑身酥软，躺在床上。
张有权脱去了王艳的衣服，再三下两下脱去自己的衣服，饿狼一般扑上去。
……
寂静，死一样的寂静。
王艳突然暴怒道：“你怎么回事，是不是和别的女人睡过了？”
“没有，真的没有。”张有权委屈地解释。
“没有，你就这个样子？你看看你还像个男人不，你就是一个废物！”

“你别这么说，我再休息一下，我肯定能恢复的。”
“算了吧，你啥时行过？看你兴冲冲的样子，我还以为你这次能行！唉，我真是命苦，自从嫁给你，跟守寡差不了多少！”
“王艳，你别泄气，我去找名医，一定能治好的！”
“我信你个鬼，你给我滚犊子！”
扑通！
张有权被王艳一脚踹下来，掉在地上。
王艳年轻时是练体育的，擅长短跑和跳远。
幸好这一脚踹在张有权的屁股上，要是踹在肋部，能给他踹骨折。
张有权嘶嘶抽着凉气，从地上爬起来，一瘸一拐地来到客厅。
叶开担心他会来次卧睡觉，躲在门口，大气也不敢出。
真是怕什么就来什么，张有权真的走进次卧。
他看见床上躺着一个姑娘，咦了一声，向前一看，认出了是王琳。
张有权叹了一口气，又出去了。
他在客厅沙发上躺下。
叶开暗暗叫苦，只能等张有权睡着了在伺机脱身。
张有权心里憋屈，他大老远的跑回家，本想跟王艳亲热一番，谁知竟然不管用，还被王艳一脚踹下床，要是传出去，能丢死人。
张有权在沙发上翻来覆去，就是睡不着。
沙发小，张有权个子接近一米八，躺在上面不得劲。
他爬起来往卧室走去，想上大床睡觉。
门已经王艳关上了，张有权推了推门，纹丝不动。
content_en:
"Why are you back?" Wang Yan's voice came out.
"Hey, I miss you, come back and see you!" It was Zhang Quanquan's voice,
Ye Kai suddenly became nervous, why did Zhang Quan come back?
"I don't believe it. It hasn't even been a day and you already miss me?"
"After the meeting, I thought it was pointless to stay in the county, so I came back."
"Let me tell you, you are so good!"
"I really miss you. I had dinner with a group of people at noon. I ate mutton balls and drank three whips of wine. Now I feel uncomfortable holding it in!"
"You're not looking for a lady outside?"
"Don't talk nonsense, I have such a beautiful daughter-in-law at home, how can I find a young lady!"
"Hmph, who knows whether you're looking for it or not?"
"Won't you know if you try it?" Zhang Quanquan hugged Wang Yan and started to move.
"No." Wang Yan was evasive.
Zhang Quanquan got even more excited, hugging Wang Yan and touching her.
Wang Yan's tenderness had not yet passed, and she was soon touched and felt soft all over, lying on the bed.
Zhang Quanquan took off Wang Yan's clothes, took off his own clothes again and again, and pounced on her like a hungry wolf.
…
Silence, deathly silence.
Wang Yan suddenly said angrily: "What's wrong with you? Have you slept with another woman?"
"No, really not." Zhang Quanquan explained aggrievedly.
"No, you are like this? Look, do you still look like a man? You are a waste!"
"Don't say that. If I take some rest, I will definitely be able to recover."
"Forget it, when have you ever done it? Looking at your excited look, I thought you could do it this time! Alas, my life is really miserable. Since marrying you, it's not much different from being a widow!"
"Wang Yan, don't be discouraged. I'll go find a famous doctor and I'll definitely be able to cure you!"
"I believe you, you idiot, get out of here!"
Thump!
Zhang Quanquan was kicked down by Wang Yan and fell to the ground.
Wang Yan practiced sports when she was young and was good at sprinting and long jump.
Fortunately, this kick landed on Zhang Quanquan's butt. If it had hit his ribs, it would have broken his bones.
Zhang Quanquan hissed and gasped, got up from the ground, and limped to the living room.
Ye Kai was worried that he would come to sleep in the second bedroom, so he hid at the door and did not dare to express his anger.
He really came to whatever he was afraid of, Zhang Quanquan really walked into the second bedroom.
When he saw a girl lying on the bed, he let out a sigh, looked forward, and recognized Wang Lin.
Zhang Quanquan sighed and went out again.
He lay down on the living room sofa.
Ye Kai complained secretly and could only wait for Zhang Quanquan to fall asleep and wait for an opportunity to escape.
Zhang Quanquan felt aggrieved. He ran all the way home, hoping to have some intimacy with Wang Yan, but it didn't work. He was kicked out of bed by Wang Yan. If word spread, it would be embarrassing.
Zhang Quanquan tossed and turned on the sofa, but couldn't fall asleep.
The sofa was small, and Zhang Quanquan, who was nearly 1.8 meters tall, felt uncomfortable lying on it.
He got up and walked to the bedroom, wanting to sleep on the big bed.
Wang Yan had already closed the door. Zhang Quanquan pushed the door, but it didn't move.
